function.description: Read ANY wallet's RECENT ACTIVITY on one chain (up to 25 transactions, newest first): receive / send / swap / failed rows with exact amounts, the counterparty when it is obvious, fees, and a per-token NET FLOW over the rows read (computed here — not a cost-basis PnL). Solana (base58) and EVM (0x, needs chain). For any address other than our own it also lists OUR recorded payments to it (the audit ledger) — use it before calling a payment unverified. Read-only.
function.name: defi_data_wallet_activity

address.description: The WALLET whose recent activity to read — any owner. Solana is base58; EVM is 0x… (40 hex). For a token's history use token_origin.

chain.description: Omit for a base58 address (read on solana). REQUIRED for a 0x address — the same 0x wallet has different activity on each EVM chain.

limit.description: How many recent transactions to show (max 25).
